poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Set the bar across your upper back and brace with your feet about shoulder-width apart.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Bend your hips and knees, keeping your heels down and knees tracking with your toes.

poses.label: Bottom
poses.description: Reach a depth you can control with your heels planted and back steady.

poses.label: Rise
poses.description: Push through your whole foot and stand back up.

checks: Bar on upper back, planted feet, coordinated hip and knee bend, roughly parallel depth and return.
Compared pose captions with the exact built-in exercise cue.
Checked camera bounds, equipment anchoring, and contact throughout the interpolated loop.
limitations: The simplified figure and fixed camera show the main movement path. In-app phone playback and admin review are pending.
The fixed camera and full-size plates can partially obscure the hands or bar.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
